notFound: This title is not in the library, or not any more.

problem.importPending: The download is done, but Radarr has not imported it yet. Radarr shows under Activity what it is waiting for.
problem.importBlocked: Radarr stopped the import because something does not fit, for example a different movie or an unexpected file. Radarr shows the reason under Activity.
problem.downloadError: The download client reports an error for this download. Radarr shows under Activity what went wrong.
problem.downloadWarning: The download client reports a warning for this download. Radarr shows under Activity what it is about.
problem.unknown: The download is stuck. Radarr shows under Activity why.

versions.title: Versions
versions.intro: Each version is its own edition of this title, for example Full HD and 4K.

origin.ownerFed: Added by you, now from Radarr: {{name}}

automatic.title: Automatic search
automatic.intro: When nexcrate searches this movie by itself and what the last search found.
automatic.off: Automation is off, nexcrate does not search this movie by itself.
automatic.searchNowHint: Searches all indexers right away and downloads the best fitting release.
automatic.started: The automatic search is running. What it finds shows up here shortly.

reason.anchor: nexcrate does not search before the release. The first search comes once the movie is out.
reason.schedule: On schedule: often right after the release, less often later.
reason.limit: The indexers have no requests left right now. nexcrate searches as soon as some are free again.
reason.replacement: A download failed. nexcrate is about to look for another release.
reason.replacement_limit: Three downloads failed in the last 24 hours. nexcrate only searches again on schedule.
reason.no_date: Without a date nexcrate searches less often and checks whether one turns up.
reason.nothing_wanted: No version is waiting for a release right now, for example because everything is here or still downloading.
reason.off: Automation is off, so nexcrate does not search by itself.
reason.wish: Another program asked for a search. nexcrate searches at once, also with the automatic off.
